# Third-party design analyses

Unofficial, inspired analyses of public company sites, kept here as design
prior art only.

These files are **not** official brand documentation, are not fact-checked
against a source of truth, and are **not** standards. Do not cite them as
authority, copy their token values, or treat their component claims as
decisions.

| File | Subject |
|---|---|
| `anthropic.md` | Anthropic |
| `apple.md` | Apple |
| `notion.md` | Notion |
| `openai.md` | OpenAI |
| `stripe.md` | Stripe |
| `vercel.md` | Vercel |

**How to use:** read for composition, type, color, and interaction ideas;
translate any borrowed idea into DabWave tokens and decisions. The normative
core is [`core.md`](../../core.md); principles and decisions are in
[`GOVERNANCE.md`](../../GOVERNANCE.md). No page in this folder overrides either.
